assistant_cost.name: assistant_cost
assistant_cost.value: typeof("assistant_admissions"."reserved_cost_micros")='integer' AND "assistant_admissions"."reserved_cost_micros" BETWEEN 0 AND 2000000 AND ("assistant_admissions"."actual_cost_micros" IS NULL OR (typeof("assistant_admissions"."actual_cost_micros")='integer' AND "assistant_admissions"."actual_cost_micros" BETWEEN 0 AND "assistant_admissions"."reserved_cost_micros"))

assistant_action.name: assistant_action
assistant_action.value: ("assistant_admissions"."action"='retrieve' AND "assistant_admissions"."weight"=0 AND "assistant_admissions"."principal_id" IS NULL AND "assistant_admissions"."debit_entry_id" IS NULL AND "assistant_admissions"."state"='completed' AND "assistant_admissions"."reserved_cost_micros"=0) OR ("assistant_admissions"."action" IN ('qa','planner','draft') AND "assistant_admissions"."weight"=IIF("assistant_admissions"."action"='qa',1,4) AND "assistant_admissions"."principal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assistant_admissions"."debit_entry_id" IS NOT NULL)

credit_ledger_bounds.name: credit_ledger_bounds
credit_ledger_bounds.value: typeof("credit_ledger"."sequence")='integer' AND "credit_ledger"."sequence" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof("credit_ledger"."requested_amount")='integer' AND "credit_ledger"."requested_amount" BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof("credit_ledger"."applied_amount")='integer' AND "credit_ledger"."applied_amount" BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof("credit_ledger"."resulting_balance")='integer' AND "credit_ledger"."resulting_balance" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991

credit_ledger_direction.name: credit_ledger_direction
credit_ledger_direction.value: ("credit_ledger"."operation"='credit' AND "credit_ledger"."requested_amount">0 AND "credit_ledger"."applied_amount" BETWEEN 0 AND "credit_ledger"."requested_amount" AND "credit_ledger"."original_entry_id" IS NULL) OR ("credit_ledger"."operation"='debit' AND "credit_ledger"."requested_amount"<0 AND "credit_ledger"."applied_amount"="credit_ledger"."requested_amount" AND "credit_ledger"."original_entry_id" IS NULL) OR ("credit_ledger"."operation"='refund' AND "credit_ledger"."requested_amount">0 AND "credit_ledger"."applied_amount" BETWEEN 0 AND "credit_ledger"."requested_amount" AND "credit_ledger"."original_entry_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("credit_ledger"."operation"='claim' AND "credit_ledger"."requested_amount"=0 AND "credit_ledger"."applied_amount"=0 AND "credit_ledger"."original_entry_id" IS NULL)

credit_ledger_metadata.name: credit_ledger_metadata
credit_ledger_metadata.value: length("credit_ledger"."kind") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND length("credit_ledger"."idempotency_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND (("credit_ledger"."reference_type" IS NULL AND "credit_ledger"."reference_id" IS NULL) OR ("credit_ledger"."reference_type" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_ledger"."reference_id" IS NOT NULL AND length("credit_ledger"."reference_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND length("credit_ledger"."reference_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200))

credit_principal_identity.name: credit_principal_identity
credit_principal_identity.value: ("credit_principals"."type"='guest' AND "credit_principals"."guest_key_hash" IS NOT NULL AND length("credit_principals"."guest_key_hash")=64 AND "credit_principals"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("credit_principals"."type"='account' AND "credit_principals"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_principals"."guest_key_hash" IS NULL)

policy_values_valid.name: policy_values_valid
policy_values_valid.value: COALESCE(json_valid(policy_json) AND json_type(policy_json)='object' AND json_type(policy_json,'$.qaCredits')='integer' AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.qaCredits') BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND json_type(policy_json,'$.plannerCredits')='integer' AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.plannerCredits') BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND json_type(policy_json,'$.guestFirst')='integer' AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.guestFirst') BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND json_type(policy_json,'$.opening')='integer' AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.opening') BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND json_type(policy_json,'$.attendanceDaily')='integer' AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.attendanceDaily') BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND json_type(policy_json,'$.attendanceDay7')='integer' AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.attendanceDay7') BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND json_type(policy_json,'$.quizCorrect')='integer' AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.quizCorrect') BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND json_type(policy_json,'$.accountFirst')='integer' AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.accountFirst') BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND json_type(policy_json,'$.monthlyLimitUsd')='integer' AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.monthlyLimitUsd') BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND json_type(policy_json,'$.monthlyWarningUsd')='integer' AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.monthlyWarningUsd') BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND json_extract(policy_json,'$.monthlyWarningUsd')<=json_extract(policy_json,'$.monthlyLimitUsd'),0)

monthly_period_valid.name: monthly_period_valid
monthly_period_valid.value: length(month)=7 AND month GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(month,6,2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12'

monthly_reserved_micros_safe.name: monthly_reserved_micros_safe
monthly_reserved_micros_safe.value: typeof(reserved_micros)='integer' AND reconciled_reserved_micros BETWEEN 0 AND reserved_micros

monthly_actual_micros_safe.name: monthly_actual_micros_safe
monthly_actual_micros_safe.value: typeof(actual_micros)='integer' AND actual_micros BETWEEN 0 AND reconciled_reserved_micros

monthly_attempts_safe.name: monthly_attempts_safe
monthly_attempts_safe.value: typeof(attempts)='integer' AND known_attempts BETWEEN 0 AND attempts
